title: Ensuring Essential Services are Not Affected by Flash Floods
what_it_is: Ensuring Essential Services are Not Affected by Flash Floods

sections.label: PUB source-pathway-receptor flood approach
sections.summary: PUB uses a source-pathway-receptor approach covering Singapore's whole drainage system to prevent and mitigate floods.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: To prevent and mitigate floods, PUB adopts a comprehensive "source-pathway-receptor" approach that covers Singapore's entire drainage system, addressing flood protection not just along the drains and canals through which stormwater travels, but also in areas generating stormwater runoff and areas where floods may occur.

sections.label: Runoff control for new developments
sections.summary: Since January 2014, new developments and redevelopments of 0.2 ha or more must control peak runoff entering the public drainage system.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: To further increase our flood resilience, since January 2014, all new developments and redevelopments of 0.2 ha or more are required to control the peak runoff entering the public drainage system.

sections.label: Reduction in flood-prone areas
sections.summary: Flood-prone areas have fallen from 3,200 ha in the 1970s to 32 ha today despite increased urbanisation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health and the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Despite increased urbanisation, flood-prone areas have been reduced from 3,200 ha in the 1970s to 32 ha today.

sections.label: Essential services not disrupted
sections.summary: The speaker says he checked and essential services, including public transport, had not been disrupted.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have said, I have checked and essential services had not been disrupted, including public transport.

sections.label: Hospital access and flood risk
sections.summary: The speaker says he has no information of hospital access being blocked, and cites advance warnings and work with SCDF, LTA and other agencies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The purpose of asking that is just to assess the risk to accessibility to our hospitals in future, whether there is a risk of an extended blockage of access to hospitals due to flooding.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: I said that based on the information I have − and I have actually made the effort to check through the records of flash floods that occurred over recent times − I do not have any information of access being blocked.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As far as I am concerned, there was no blockage to access to hospitals.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have said, we have advance warnings to the public and we also work very closely with SCDF, LTA and all the other agencies.
